title: Bi-Lipschitz images of Borel, locally H^n-finite subsets of U
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U, M ⊆ ℝ^P with M Borel, M ⊆ U, and H^n(M ∩ C) < ∞ for every compact C ⊆ U, where H^n = μHE[n]. Let φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be Λ-Lipschitz and Λ'-antilipschitz (|x − y| ≤ Λ'|φ(x) − φ(y)| for all x, y; Λ, Λ' ≥ 0) with φ^{-1}(U) = U. Then φ(M) is Borel, φ(M) ⊆ U, and H^n(φ(M) ∩ C) < ∞ for every compact C ⊆ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ Λ' : NNReal), MeasurableSet M → M ⊆ U → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M ∩ C) ≠ ∞) → LipschitzWith Λ φ → AntilipschitzWith Λ' φ → φ ⁻¹' U = U → MeasurableSet (φ '' M) ∧ φ '' M ⊆ U ∧ ∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → μHE[n] (φ '' M ∩ C) ≠ ∞
